evidence_items.explanation: SATBench reports performance well above its 50% chance baseline on generated, solver-checked puzzles, without allowing external tools during model evaluation. Reasoning-trace checks and partial human validation support a limited inference capability, although they also reveal errors.

Controlled puzzle experiments show substantial limits and failures at higher complexity. Those findings constrain claims of general or reliable reasoning, but do not establish the absence of all reasoning capability.
